basic.title: Senior / Staff Machine Learning Engineer
basic.location: City of San Fernando, Pampanga, Philippines | Remote | Hybrid | Open to relocation
basic.summary: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer with 8+ years building and shipping production AI systems, focused on LLM platforms, multi-agent systems, and RAG. Builds ML products end to end, from synthetic data and fine-tuning small models to running large models on GPUs and setting up the MLOps and monitoring around them. Work spans conversational search, healthcare documentation, and energy and industrial use cases, across both larger companies and fast-moving startup clients. Strong at taking workflows that run on big frontier models and turning them into smaller fine-tuned models that are faster and cheaper in production.

experience.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist / MLOps
bullets: Led the design and deployment of generative AI systems for real-time medical documentation at a healthcare startup client, helping reduce clinician note-taking time by over 63% and improving care delivery efficiency.
Built conversational AI agent systems for a high-growth online marketplace client, shaping assistants that served both buyers and service providers.
Contributed across knowledge-graph-driven retrieval, multi-turn reasoning, and agent orchestration as part of the client's core applied-AI research workstream.
Drove exploration of novel approaches for ranking, reasoning, and retrieval, central to A&R's 2025 roadmap.
Designed synthetic multi-turn conversation datasets and fine-tuned lightweight in-house SLMs for accurate user–query mapping and tool-call extraction.
Developed and tested agentic workflows grounded in real search behaviors, improving personalization and task success rates.
Drove A/B experimentation and rollout for conversational discovery features using feature flags, traffic ramping, CloudWatch, Datadog, and offline/online eval dashboards.

Framed multi-turn conversational search as a structured generation task in which the model consumed prior user/assistant turns, including intermediate tool calls, and predicted the final normalized tool call after the latest user refinement.

Generated synthetic multi-turn training conversations from real search/session logs using GPT-4o and GPT-5 to expand coverage of paraphrases, slot overwrites, clarification turns, and edge-case tool-call patterns.
Benchmarked GPT-4/4o/5-class models for multi-turn query understanding and tool-call extraction, then distilled the workflow into fine-tuned SLMs for lower-latency, lower-cost production serving.

Ran end-to-end experiments across frontier-model teacher pipelines, short vs. long dialogue histories, reasoning vs. non-reasoning prompts, and multiple student SLM families, optimizing final tool-call extraction quality rather than proxy generation metrics.

Fine-tuned open-weight SLMs (llama, qwen, etc) for conversational query understanding and tool-call extraction using SFT, LoRA, and RL-style post-training, and served them with vLLM/SGLang on AWS Kubernetes, first via hosted inference providers and later on self-hosted GPU pods.

Iterated on prompt design and post-training objectives to reduce hallucinated arguments, improve safeguard behavior and schema adherence, and strengthen query understanding under ambiguous or incomplete travel requests.
Tracked prompt, fine-tuning, and evaluation experiments in Weights & Biases and MLflow across frontier-model baselines, synthetic-data variants, and distilled SLM checkpoints.
Automated training, reindexing, and deployment workflows for conversational retrieval and ranking models using Airflow/MWAA, SageMaker Pipelines, Terraform, and Jenkins.

Built end-to-end production observability across query understanding, retrieval, ranking, and generation using Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, CloudWatch, and LLM tracing tools to monitor latency, failures, schema violations, low-confidence outputs, and retrieval-quality regressions.

Led architecture and delivery of multi-agent and LLM-based applications for oil-and-gas workflows as a member of the Viridien AI Lab, using Neo4j and Kubeflow to integrate domain data, which enabled faster decision-making for drilling teams.

Designed and built multi-agent systems with LangGraph, React, Docker, and Kubernetes that supported seismic interpretation and drilling engineering, reducing prototype development time by several weeks.

Developed a domain-specific search and retrieval system for drilling-engineering documents (reports, logs, specs, PDFs, charts, manuals) using SparkSQL, Neo4j and Tesseract OCR, which increased relevant-document recall for engineers.
Fine-tuned LLMs and embedding models with drilling terminology, achieving higher accuracy in natural-language query responses for technical results.

Built semantic and multimodal RAG pipelines using Kubeflow and LangGraph to retrieve text, tables, plots, and scanned documents from large oil-and-gas corpora, cutting information-search time for engineers.
Delivered large-scale LLM inference systems, deploying 3B-600B-parameter models on H100 GPU clusters with vLLM and SGLang, enabling real-time responses for high-throughput query workloads.
Optimized inference latency and throughput on both Kubernetes and bare metal GPU environments.
Built an AI-driven video summarization tool and evaluated multimodal retrieval models for downstream analytics, reducing manual review time for video content.
Designed and productionized end-to-end ML pipelines on GCP with Vertex AI, GKE, Cloud Composer, Terraform, and Cloud Build, reducing model deployment time and enabling automated training cycles.
Built document ingestion and embedding pipelines using Cloud Storage and Vertex AI to enable semantic search at scale.
Implemented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines on GCP using FAISS, LangChain, and custom APIs for internal knowledge bases, accelerating answer generation for employee queries.
Integrated Neo4j with RAG pipelines to build knowledge graphs from enterprise documents and improve structured discovery.
Built PDF extraction pipelines using Gemini 2.5 on GCP, enabling automated ingestion of structured documents and reducing manual processing time.
Developed OCR and KIE pipelines using PyTorch and PyTorch Lightning, deployed on GKE with over 40 percent inference speed improvement.
Fine-tuned models on GCP GPUs with Vertex AI Workbench, tracking experiments in MLflow and Weights & Biases, which improved model accuracy and shortened training cycles.
Built real-time monitoring and alerting for ML services using Stackdriver, Pub/Sub, and Datadog, allowing faster detection of issues and decreasing service downtime.
Automated ETL, data validation, and model workflows with Cloud Composer, Airflow, and Kubeflow Pipelines, cutting manual effort and speeding up data processing.
Built and managed a Vertex AI Feature Store using the Python SDK, enabling feature reuse and enforcing governance across teams, which streamlined feature engineering and reduced duplicate work.

Processed multi-terabyte datasets with PySpark on Dataproc, applying SparkSQL for transformation, and loaded curated tables into BigQuery for analytics and modeling, accelerating data availability for downstream models.
Developed REST and gRPC inference APIs with FastAPI, containerized them, and deployed to Cloud Run and GKE, delivering low-latency model serving that supported real-time applications.
Refactored legacy automation scripts (Python/Bash) into scalable GKE jobs, enhancing reliability and fault tolerance, which decreased job failures and lowered maintenance overhead.
Designed RPA and browser automation workflows with Selenium and GCP services, enabling faster document and payment processing.
Migrated data and ML workflows from AWS to GCP, incorporating Snowflake, BigQuery, and orchestration pipelines, which streamlined data access and reduced latency.
Supported CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, Terraform, and Artifact Registry, ensuring consistent and reliable ML deployments.
Mentored junior ML engineers and conducted code, architecture, and deployment reviews using GitLab and Weights & Biases, which raised code quality standards and accelerated model release cycles.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built automation systems for event registration and payment processing workflows, reducing manual effort and improving operational scalability.
Developed RPA solutions using Selenium to automate repetitive business processes across registration and data entry systems.
Designed ML-powered document processing pipelines to extract structured data from forms and registration documents.
Built OCR systems to process scanned forms and documents, enabling efficient digitization of event data.
Improved document processing accuracy by developing CNN-based text detection and extraction models.
Developed NLP pipelines to extract entities and insights from registration and financial data sources.
Automated validation and verification workflows for attendee and payment records, improving data accuracy and compliance.
Built monitoring dashboards to track automation workflows and system performance in real time.
Developed scalable ETL pipelines for ingesting and transforming event-related and financial datasets.
Improved operational efficiency through AI-driven automation, reducing turnaround time for key business processes.
Integrated ML models with RPA systems to enable intelligent decision-making within automation workflows.
Built scalable data pipelines using Airflow, PySpark, and cloud-based infrastructure.
Optimized OCR pipelines using Tesseract and advanced image preprocessing techniques to improve extraction quality.
Developed computer vision models for table detection, layout parsing, and document structure understanding.
Built performance monitoring tools to evaluate ML model accuracy and system throughput.
Improved system reliability through logging, alerting, and observability best practices.
Deployed ML and automation services using Docker and cloud platforms for scalable production usage.
Collaborated with stakeholders to design automation solutions aligned with business requirements and workflows.
Enhanced processing throughput for high-volume event data pipelines, supporting large-scale operations.
Contributed to early AI-driven automation initiatives combining machine learning and RPA technologies.
